title: AI药物走到三期：抗衰老只是附加，40多款储备能否再造爆款？
speaker: Alex Zhavoronkov

segments.en: Well, the beauty of this drug is that it's currently in phase three. So we've taken it from very early stage from the very discovery when we discover it,
segments.zh: 这款药物的亮点在于它目前正处于三期临床阶段。我们从最初发现它的时候，

segments.en: the molecular mechanism and the therapeutic target and discover it, the actual small molecule that people can now take in order to try the drug.
segments.zh: 从发现分子机制和治疗靶点，到发现人们现在可以服用的实际小分子药物，我们一路推进。

segments.en: And we've taken it all the way to phase three. So now we will see in the context of the larger study if the drug sustains its effect on the lung.
segments.zh: 我们已将其推进到三期。现在，我们将在更大规模的研究中观察该药物对肺部的效果能否持续。

segments.en: And we are of course continuing to collect this proteomic data to be able to see if it also can sustain the effect on the age. So if it sustains, it might take a couple or maybe even more years for the study to conclude. We will see if it works, if it works. That's phenomenal.
segments.zh: 我们当然会继续收集蛋白质组数据，以观察其对年龄的效果是否持续。如果效果持续，研究可能需要几年甚至更长时间才能结束。我们将看到它是否有效。如果有效，那就太棒了。

segments.en: We can try to expand the indications. So first of all, you would have to follow the very similar template as GLP1s. GLP1s are Kardashians of all drugs right now, right?
segments.zh: 我们可以尝试扩大适应症。首先，我们需要遵循类似GLP-1药物的模式。GLP-1药物现在是药物界的“卡戴珊”，对吧？

segments.en: And both LLL and Nava Nordisk paved the way for how to develop a drug for a disease later repurpose it for a biological condition such as obesity.
segments.zh: 礼来和诺和诺德为如何开发一种疾病药物、然后将其重新用于肥胖等生物状况铺平了道路。

segments.en: And right now, I can tell you that I am on GLP1s. I am on LLL and sometimes I'm on those antics. I'm an equal opportunity, you know, a really user on microdosing.
segments.zh: 现在，我可以告诉你，我正在使用GLP-1药物。我用礼来的，有时也用其他品牌的。我是一个机会均等的使用者，微剂量使用。

segments.en: So that drug has not yet demonstrated the effect on aging and pretty sure it will. But our is has a very strong effect right now based on the data we see.
segments.zh: GLP-1药物尚未证明对衰老有效，但我确信它会的。而我们的药物根据现有数据，目前显示出非常强的效果。

segments.en: And again, it's very early preliminary. If it gets approved for a disease, you might be able to expand it for aging and plus at Encelico, we have 40 plus drugs in addition to this one.
segments.zh: 当然，这还很早期。如果它获批用于某种疾病，我们或许能将其扩展至抗衰老领域。此外，英矽智能还有40多款其他药物。

segments.en: So it means that we have many shots on goal to demonstrate that it works. This philosophy works, aging first philosophy works. And then if everybody is on a planet as your patient, the market is vast.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们有很多机会来证明其有效性。这种“衰老优先”的理念是可行的。如果地球上的每个人都是潜在患者，市场将是巨大的。

segments.en: We are not actually very financially driven in this particular angle, right? So we want to approve for a disease first. That's the major important direction. But aging here is an icing on the cake.
segments.zh: 我们在这个角度上并不是非常受财务驱动。我们首先希望药物获批用于疾病治疗，这是最重要的方向。而抗衰老只是锦上添花。
